[2026-08-15T21:39:46.787Z] [2026-08-15] RECORD GEM — CANONICAL FORMULATION LOCKED

RECORD GEM = Identity + Context + Actions (Intelligence is a later layer)

ARCHITECTURE:
                 RECORD
                   │
          ┌────────┼────────┐
          ▼        ▼        ▼
      IDENTITY   CONTEXT   ACTIONS
                            │
                            ▼
                    user interaction
                            │
                            ▼
                     RECORD EVENTS
                            │
                            ▼
                     INTELLIGENCE

IDENTITY — what the record IS
  recordType, status, date, title, slug, referenceNumber

CONTEXT — what surrounds it
  location, relatedArea, relatedCampaign, originNotice, parentRecord,
  environmentalContext, attendance, participation window

ACTIONS — what the user can meaningfully do (context-aware, not generic)
  Resolved at render time from Identity + Context.
  Not every record gets every action.
  Examples:
    meeting → Attending/Maybe/Not attending + Add to Calendar
    notice → Submit Response + Add Reminder + View Documents
    developmentNotice → View Notice + View Evidence + Add Reminder

INTELLIGENCE — institutional interpretation of what happens around the GEM
  Comes AFTER actions. Phases 5-7 are intelligence infrastructure.
  Do NOT expand Phase 7 into more intelligence dimensions yet.

WHY SCHEMA EXERCISE CAME FIRST:
  Fields are not just fields — they are action-enabling context.
  recordType + date + attendance → meeting actions
  participationDeadline + status → notice actions
  The canonical schema must be clean before the GEM can resolve actions reliably.

CORRECT NEXT SEQUENCE:
  1. Canonical Record schema remodel in ~/umkhandlu (7-step sequence)
  2. Context-aware Action model — given any Record, determine available actions
  3. Reusable GEM component — renders any record in any context (card/page/calendar/participation)
  4. Intelligence layer in Control Centre (builds on top of GEM, not inside it)

CONCRETE TEST CASE:
  KwaGudlucingo Community Meeting
  recordType=meeting, date=27 June 2026, location=KwaGudlucingo, attendance=[]
  → GEM resolves: Attending / Maybe / Not attending + Add to Calendar
  This must work from the same component that renders a developmentNotice differently.

IMMEDIATE DIRECTION: Civic platform reusable context-aware Record component (~/umkhandlu frontend)
